title: Shortcuts
shortDescription: Folders of your choice in the Command Palette main search, ranked by how often you start them.
description: Shortcuts catalogues folders of your choice into the Command Palette main search. The files in them, filtered by extension, show up as top-level commands that Command Palette ranks by how often and how recently you start them. Scripts (.ps1, .cmd, .bat; .ps1 needs PowerShell 7, pwsh) run in their own folder and remember the arguments they were started with; links (.lnk, .url) and programs (.exe) start on Enter. New, deleted and renamed files show up without a restart. An example folder with a small script gets you started.
